residence-yasmine-ennasr.title: Yasmine Residence
residence-yasmine-ennasr.tagline: Funding the completion of 24 apartments in Ennasr
residence-yasmine-ennasr.description: The structural work is complete and 60% of the units are already reserved. The funds top up the equity the bank requires to finance the finishing works. Investors are repaid as the apartments are sold.
risks: Capital not guaranteed; no resale before maturity

dar-diaspora-sahloul.title: Dar Diaspora — Sahloul
dar-diaspora-sahloul.tagline: 6 furnished apartments to let near the universities of Sousse
dar-diaspora-sahloul.description: A project company buys six apartments and lets them to students and young professionals. Net rental income is distributed every year; the apartments are sold at maturity.

sakan-step-sfax.title: Sakan Step — Sfax El Jadida
sakan-step-sfax.tagline: Three families become homeowners step by step
sakan-step-sfax.description: The company buys three apartments. Each family pays rent and buys shares in its home every month until it owns it outright. Sukuk structure, compliant with Islamic finance.
highlights: Home ownership without a bank loan
risks: Legal framework for rent-to-own still to be confirmed

dar-medina-tunis.title: Dar Lebna — Medina of Tunis
dar-medina-tunis.tagline: Restoring a traditional house as a guest house
dar-medina-tunis.description: Restoration of a 19th-century dar (traditional courtyard house) into an 8-room guest house, run by a specialist operator. Investors receive a share of the operating profit.
